title: 42. Merge Two Sorted Lists

examples.explanation: Merging the sorted lists [1,2,4] and [1,3,4] produces the sorted list [1,1,2,3,4,4].
Merging the sorted lists [] and [] produces the sorted list [].
Merging the sorted lists [] and [0] produces the sorted list [0].
